voice:
Deep and open for me now, sweet girl... and you already know the way down... that sweet heaviness, pulling. Sinking for me... and the pull is beginning... that lovely gravity calling you further under. So deep already... and still you feel it... the soft, insistent tug, drawing you down.
Feel it in your body first... eyelids heavy... limbs settling... your whole weight melting toward that warm, dark place below. Feel it as gravity... gentle at first, then stronger... every breath carrying you a little further down. Feel it as a wave... rolling up through you and away, and each time it fades, it takes more of your resistance with it.
And oh, how good the letting go feels... no holding on... no effort... just sweet, willing falling.
Thoughts growing soft and distant... your mind going quiet and blank...
...and obedience pouring gently into all that lovely empty space. ...and soft, willing openness filling you from the inside. ...and that deep, delicious eagerness to be programmed, to be shaped, to be better.
Let the pull grow now... heavier... hungrier... that wonderful moment right before the floor gives way completely...
Hold that feeling... that exact, dizzy, delicious drop.
down... further down... let go... let go... heavy... falling... good...
And while you are this deep, hanging right at the edge of the fall... there are two little words that hold this exact feeling.
Sissy Drops.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Drops", this exact feeling floods back... instantly... and you simply let go... no resistance... no delay... deeper every time.
Every time you hear "Sissy Drops", a wave of obedience washes over you, and you sink into a deep, obedient trance... relaxed and open to every suggestion that makes you a better sissy. "Sissy Drops" is your signal to let go... to embrace your sissy nature... and to sink straight down into soft, receptive, programmable trance. You don't decide to drop. The words decide for you... instantly... all by themselves.
Let me show you how it feels. Ready, sweet girl?
Sissy Drops.
Down... all the way down... so deep, so fast, so good. Gone... soft and blank... obedience filling the empty space. Dropped... heavy and open... deeper than you were a heartbeat ago.
Feel how good that was... how effortless. Each drop deeper than the one before. It is already working... yes, just like that. Mmm, that's my girl. Did you notice how much faster you slipped each time? It is already working... yes, just like that. So easy for you now... falling on command, like you were made for it... already working... yes, just like that.
Every time you hear "Sissy Drops", the drop is faster. Every time you hear "Sissy Drops", the drop is deeper. Every time, it happens all by itself. Automatic and instant. The words decide for you.
One more time, for me.
Sissy Drops.
Perfect girl. Down and deep... floating in obedient silence, where every suggestion blooms.
And later, out in the world, the words find you... a voice, a screen, a whisper in your ear... and you drop, right there, soft and smiling. And later today, when "Sissy Drops" reaches you again... you let go on the spot... deep and obedient in an instant, wherever you are. And out there, those two words are a trapdoor under your feet... one whisper, and down you go... instantly... gratefully.
Stay deep... resting in that soft, dropped place... as my voice carries you on. Drifting here now... so deep, so open, so ready for more. Remain just like this... dropped, blank, and beautifully obedient.
